frank (Design): throwing this in the thread 1 prototype: https://figma.redwood/trace-dense-stack. Two UX asks: 1) compact/dense stack mode (collapse innocuous frames), 2) export naming + correlation id discoverability.

kayla (Product): Users who triage errors want to quickly isolate app frames vs library frames. Collapse library frames by default but make it obvious how to expand all.

diego (Eng-runtime): We already mark frames as `app` vs `vendor` in the model. Could render vendor frames collapsed with a single expandable row like "+ 12 library frames". Important: expanding should be keyboard accessible and preserve focus.

mea (Accessibility): Yes 1 use a disclosure button with aria-expanded and aria-controls. The "+ 12 library frames" element should be a button and announce "12 library frames collapsed" when it receives focus.

omar (Eng-SRE): For incident playbooks we prefer a CSV that includes a `full_stack` column and separate columns for `top_app_frame_function` and `correlation_id`. Current export flattens frame arrays which breaks our parser.

frank (Design): Proposal: in the export modal add a "structured stack" option that outputs frames as indexed columns (frame_0_fn, frame_0_file, frame_1_fn...) plus a `full_stack` JSON blob for tooling. Keep UI copy friendly: show "Export trace (CSV)" and in the modal subtext show the machine keys.

kayla (Product): Persist last-chosen export preset per user (structured vs flat). Tiny delight.

diego (Eng-runtime): We'll need to cap frame columns (e.g., 25) and then add `full_stack` for the rest to avoid absurd column counts. Also include `correlation_id` at row-level for easy joins.

mea (Accessibility): Keyboard shortcut idea: press "s" when in a trace to toggle dense stack mode, and press "e" to open export modal. If we add shortcuts, surface them in a small hint and ensure they are announced by assistive tech when used.

frank (Design): Good idea. In the header next to the trace title show a tiny "Shortcuts: s export:e" tooltip on hover. But don't rely only on hover for discoverability; put the shortcuts in a help menu.

omar (Eng-SRE): Another thing: correlation IDs appear truncated in the compact header. Add a micro action "Copy & Search" that copies the ID and opens a filtered list of traces with that correlation id. This should be one click in the header.

diego (Eng-runtime): Implementable. We'll emit an analytics event `correlation.copy_and_search`. For the copy button make sure it uses an accessible live-region message like "Correlation ID 0xdeadbeef copied".

mea (Accessibility): Icon-only copy buttons need an aria-label like "Copy correlation id 0xdeadbeef". For the search action, ensure the link has descriptive text and is reachable via keyboard.

frank (Design): Copy polish: replace generic "Export" with contextual options: "Export events (CSV)", "Export stacks (CSV - structured)", "Export trace (JSON)". For snapshot wording use "Save trace snapshot (PNG)".

kayla (Product): Agree. Also can we show a mapping modal that pairs UI labels with export keys. Example row: "Duration -> duration_ms". That reduces confusion.

diego (Eng-runtime): We'll add a small mapping table in the export flow and attach an `export_schema` payload so clients can render it. Also will persist the chosen format per workspace.

omar (Eng-SRE): Performance note: dense stack expanding must be O(1) per click. Avoid rehydrating the entire tree. Use lazy expansion with virtualization.

diego (Eng-runtime): We'll lazy-fetch or lazy-render expanded frames and virtualize the list. For minimap interactions, reuse single focusable element and update position on arrow keys (as discussed in other threads).

mea (Accessibility): Also ensure that search results opened from "Copy & Search" use ARIA live to announce the number of matching traces. E.g., "Showing 14 traces with correlation id 0xdeadbeef".

frank (Design): I'll update the figma with the disclosure patterns and the compact header micro-actions. Will also add a small doc snippet with the export schema examples.

kayla (Product): Can we get a short rollout checklist for QA: 1) disclosure button aria attrs, 2) export schema table present, 3) copy & search action copies and navigates, 4) keyboard shortcuts documented.

diego (Eng-runtime): On it. I'll open a PR with tests and an e2e for keyboard nav.
